build_drop_path_layer: build a DropPath module with a given drop probability for stochastic depth in residual blocks
build_graph_drop_path: build a GraphDropPath module to drop paths considering batch indices for graph data
build_equivariant_dropout: build an EquivariantDropout module using e3nn irreps to apply equivariant dropout to tensor fields
build_equivariant_scalars_dropout: build an EquivariantScalarsDropout module that applies dropout only to scalar irreps in equivariant tensors
build_equivariant_spherical_harmonics_dr: build an EquivariantDropoutArraySphericalHarmonics module to apply dropout to 3D spherical harmonics arrays
